<span class="origin-badge origin-badge--bareos">Bareos</span>

List versions of a file.

## Synopsis

```text
.bvfs_versions [jobid=<jobid>] [client=<client>] [pathid=<pathid>]
               [path=<path>] [filename=<filename>] [fname=<fname>]
               [name=<name>] [copies] [versions] [limit=<limit>]
               [offset=<offset>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Lists all backed up versions of one file of a client across all jobs, each with its volume, so an older version can be picked for .bvfs\_restore by its FileId. Only versions stored on a volume count. jobid= is required but not evaluated (by Bareos convention 0); the directory is given by path= or pathid=, the file by fname= (also filename= or name=). copies includes versions from copy jobs; versions is accepted but has no effect.

Each line has seven tab separated columns: PathId, FileId, JobId, LStat, MD5, volume name and InChanger.

## Arguments {#arguments}

| Argument | Type | Values / source | Default | Flags | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `jobid=` | string |  |  |  | Job ID. |
| `client=` | resource | from [`.clients`](../dot-clients/) |  |  | Client name. |
| `pathid=` | integer |  |  |  | Path ID. |
| `path=` | string |  |  |  | Directory. |
| `filename=` | string |  |  |  | File name. |
| `fname=` | string |  |  |  | File name. |
| `name=` | string |  |  |  | File name. |
| `copies` | keyword |  |  |  | Include copies. |
| `versions` | keyword |  |  |  | Every version. |
| `limit=` | integer |  |  |  | Most rows. |
| `offset=` | integer |  |  |  | Rows to skip. |

## Examples

All versions of /etc/hosts:

```text
.bvfs_versions jobid=0 client=bareos-fd path=/etc/ fname=hosts
```

Including versions from copy jobs:

```text
.bvfs_versions jobid=0 client=bareos-fd path=/etc/ fname=hosts copies
```
